chars.ADIL: ADIL: a young Moroccan man wearing a mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt, dark green cargo trousers and white sneakers.
chars.HAFSA: HAFSA: a young Moroccan woman wearing a burgundy hijab, a long denim jacket over a cream dress, and small round glasses.
chars.LAMIA: LAMIA: a young Moroccan woman with no headscarf, wearing a bright turquoise hoodie with a white star on it and black leggings.
chars.GIRL: LITTLE HAFSA: a small girl wearing a pink pyjama with white polka dots and a small burgundy hair band.
chars.MOM: HAFSA'S MOTHER: a middle-aged Moroccan woman wearing a dark blue djellaba and a grey headscarf.
chars.DAD: HAFSA'S FATHER: a middle-aged Moroccan man wearing a brown leather jacket and a grey moustache drawn as a small line.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A cafe terrace in Casablanca at sunset. HAFSA sits across a small table from ADIL, leaning forward with a very serious worried face, holding his hand. ADIL looks nervous and surprised, eyebrows raised, a mint tea glass frozen in his other hand. Clear tension between them.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe terrace, closer view. HAFSA looks down and talks slowly, fiddling nervously with her fingers. ADIL listens completely frozen, wide eyes, leaning toward her.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same cafe terrace at dusk. HAFSA has a tear rolling down her cheek while she talks. ADIL looks at her with concern and confusion.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A small old apartment living room in a Moroccan city at night. LITTLE HAFSA stands in the open front doorway holding her school bag, scared, watching her FATHER and MOTHER shouting angrily at each other across the room, arms waving, a broken plate on the floor.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A tiny bare bedroom with an empty doorframe that has no door. LITTLE HAFSA sits on a thin mattress on the floor hugging her knees and crying, a small window with moonlight.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Apartment hallway. HAFSA'S MOTHER crouches, worried, buttoning a coat on LITTLE HAFSA and pointing toward the door, sending her out to a friend's house.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A cosy bedroom with posters and fairy lights. LAMIA opens her arms and gives HAFSA a big warm hug at the bedroom door, both smiling. HAFSA looks relieved.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The same cosy bedroom. HAFSA and LAMIA sit side by side on the bed laughing together, sharing a bowl of popcorn, very close and comfortable, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: View from a hallway: LAMIA is closing the bedroom door with a cheeky secretive smile while HAFSA sits on the bed inside behind her. Mysterious warm light coming from the gap of the door.
